findings.highlight: I don’t even need to think about it
findings.evidenceJa: 決意なんてするまでもなかった
findings.governingReading: No act of steeling himself or making a decision is even necessary; Shirou simply wants to protect Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English changes already-set resolve into absence of thought, weakening the moral decision sequence.

findings.highlight: because you’re that kind of person
findings.evidenceJa: シロウがそういう子だから
findings.governingReading: Illya supports Shirou because he is “that kind of child,” using her characteristic affectionate positioning of him.
findings.explanation: The English neutralizes Illya’s childlike way of categorizing and addressing Shirou.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=オヤジ char=2]切嗣が死んでから
findings.governingReading: The written text names Kiritsugu while Shirou’s ruby calls him “the old man” or Dad.
findings.explanation: The English deletes both Kiritsugu’s name and Shirou’s distinctive intimate form of reference.

findings.highlight: I tried to see her as just another fellow student
findings.evidenceJa: ずっと後輩だと思いこんで
findings.governingReading: Shirou had persistently convinced himself that Sakura was simply his junior.
findings.explanation: The English deletes their senior-junior relationship and changes entrenched self-belief into an active attempt to see her generically.

findings.highlight: I tried to see her as just another fellow student
findings.evidenceJa: 異性なんだと意識しないようにしていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou deliberately avoided becoming conscious of Sakura as a member of the opposite sex.
findings.explanation: The English folds this separate suppression into generic schoolmate framing and removes the romantic-sexual awareness he denied.

findings.highlight: If you are to protect just one person
findings.evidenceJa: たった一人を生かそうというのなら
findings.governingReading: Archer’s warning concerns choosing to keep one single person alive.
findings.explanation: The English broadens the life-or-death choice into generic protection, weakening the connection to sacrificing the many for Sakura’s survival.

findings.highlight: shoots down at me as I run
findings.evidenceJa: 走る体を撃ち抜いていく
findings.governingReading: The merciless winter rain shoots through Shirou’s running body.
findings.explanation: The English turns bodily penetration into rain merely coming down toward him.
